skeleton: round, chubby Stegosaurus standing on four stubby legs, three-quarter view turned to the left, its small head held low at the front: root on the ground under the body; body (pivot over the legs) with belly squash, the body piece carrying the throat and neck up under the head (its top a soft unoutlined edge) and its back running into the root of the tail, ending in a soft unoutlined cut the tail tucks under; plates (the row of coral back plates, one piece behind the body, its base hidden behind the back) on the belly; head (no neck, soft unoutlined bottom) on top of the neck, face with eyes (the far one smaller, near the snout), brows and mouth; four legs at the shoulders and hips, each whole to the foot: legFF and legBF (far, behind the body, shaded), legFN and legBN (near, their round outlined thighs in front of the body); foldFN/foldBN (none at rest) swap in for the near legs folded under when it lies down; tail behind the body with its little spikes, its bone at the join; a fern frond on its own bone at the mouth for munching.

sheets.prompt:
Image 1 is a sticker of a round, chubby teal Stegosaurus with darker teal spots, a cream underside and big rounded coral back plates, standing on its four stubby legs, turned a little to the left. Draw this exact Stegosaurus as a cut-out paper puppet: its separate body parts laid out on one sheet, the same drawing style, colours, texture, line and proportions as in image 1, every part at the size it has in image 1.

Draw each part on its own, spread out over the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, no part touching or overlapping another:
1. the body with its neck: the round, arched teal body with its darker teal spots and its cream underside, turned as in image 1, without head, without back plates, without legs and without tail: the arched back one smooth outlined curve with no plates on it, no legs or feet drawn on it, the cream underside one smooth round shape. At the front, the cream throat and the spotted teal back of the neck go up and forward from the broad shoulders, as wide as the neck is under the head in image 1, keeping the curved line where the back of the neck meets the shoulder as in image 1, and end in a soft, smooth edge with NO outline (it is hidden under the head). At the back, the spotted back runs on smoothly into the very root of the tail and ends there in a soft edge cut straight down, with NO outline across it (the tail tucks under it): no round bump, no stump, no line where the tail would join.
2. the back plates alone, as one piece: the row of big rounded coral plates with their darker coral stripes and dark outline, standing up side by side and overlapping each other exactly as in image 1, from the small plate just behind the head to the last medium plate over the hips; their bottoms run together into one soft band of coral with NO outline along the bottom (it is hidden behind the back).
3. the head alone, without neck: the small round head with its rounded snout, its two little nostrils, the darker teal spots on top and the rosy cheek, turned as in image 1, with a completely blank face: no eyes, no eyebrows, no mouth and no mouth line; keep the nostrils, the spots and the rosy cheek. Keep its dark outline over the top of the head, round the snout and along the jaw under the snout to the chin, and down the back of the head, as in image 1. Under the head, from the chin round to the back of the head, its bottom edge is soft, with NO outline: the cream throat and the teal back of the head simply stop there, about level with the bottom of the rosy cheek.
4. the short tail with the small soft blunt coral spikes that stand on it near its tip in image 1, drawn whole, its cream underside, its rounded tip pointing to the right, from its thick root (normally hidden inside the body) to the tip; its root a soft, smooth edge cut straight across with NO outline.
5. the far front leg: the leg on the far left of image 1, under the cream chest, drawn whole from the top of its shoulder (normally hidden behind the chest) down to its round foot with three soft, round, blunt cream toenails, as in image 1; its top a full, smooth, rounded end with NO outline across it.
6. the near front leg: the big round front leg in the middle-left of image 1, drawn whole from the top of its big round thigh down to its round foot with three soft, round, blunt cream toenails, as in image 1, the round thigh with its whole outline as in image 1.
7. the far hind leg: the leg partly hidden between the two near legs in image 1, drawn whole from the top of its thigh (normally hidden behind the tummy) down to its round foot with three soft, round, blunt cream toenails; its top a full, smooth, rounded end with NO outline across it.
8. the near hind leg: the big round hind leg on the right of image 1, drawn whole from the top of its big round thigh down to its round foot with three soft, round, blunt cream toenails, as in image 1, the round thigh with its whole outline as in image 1.
9. the near front leg as when the Stegosaurus lies down on its tummy: the same chubby front leg folded under, seen from the side, its round foot tucked forward with its three soft cream toenails showing at the front; its top a full, smooth, rounded end with NO outline across it.
10. the near hind leg as when the Stegosaurus lies down on its tummy: the same big round thigh with its whole outline, the leg folded flat under it, the round foot tucked forward with its three soft cream toenails showing at the front.
11. a small green fern frond for it to munch, a short stalk with a few soft leaflets, about as long as the head in image 1.

Every part is drawn whole, including what is normally hidden behind another part, and each joint end (where it tucks under the body or the head) is a full, smooth, rounded edge. Nothing sharp: no teeth, no pointed claws, no pointed spikes. No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a round, chubby teal Stegosaurus; image 2 shows the same Stegosaurus cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw the Stegosaurus's face pieces as separate stickers on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours and line as in image 1, every piece at the size it has on the Stegosaurus in image 1, so it fits the blank face in image 2. Its head is turned to the left: its far eye (on the left of image 1, near the snout) is smaller than its near eye (on the right of image 1). In image 1 both eyes look up and to the left: each dark-brown iris sits towards the upper left of its cream eye, the white sparkle in it.

Draw each piece on its own, upright, in four tidy rows with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
Row 1, the far eye (the smaller eye, on the LEFT of image 1), six times:
1. as it is in image 1: a cream oval eye with a big dark-brown iris and a white sparkle, looking up and to the left.
2. wide open and surprised: bigger and rounder, the dark-brown iris with its white sparkle, looking the same way.
3. closed in a happy smile: an upward-curving arc, like an upside-down U.
4. sad: open and round, the dark-brown iris with a white sparkle and a thin shine of a welling tear along its bottom rim, looking up and to the left; no lid slanting across it.
5. crying: squeezed shut, a thick lid line as wide as the open eye, curving down at both ends like a little frown, and one small light-blue teardrop just below its outer (left) end.
6. gently closed in sleep: a soft downward-curving line as wide as the open eye, with a few short lashes.
Row 2, the near eye (the bigger eye, on the RIGHT of image 1), the same six in the same order; open, it looks the same way as row 1, up and to the left, the iris towards the upper left of the eye; crying, its teardrop below its outer (right) end.
Row 3: 13. the far eyebrow (over the left eye of image 1) as it is in image 1, a short thin dark-brown arch. 14. the same far eyebrow worried: tilted up at its inner (right) end. 15. the near eyebrow (over the right eye of image 1) as it is in image 1, a thin dark-brown arch. 16. the same near eyebrow worried: tilted up at its inner (left) end.
Row 4, mouths, none with any teeth: 17. the mouth as it is in image 1: a thin, closed, shy smiling line, gently curved, curling up into a smile at its right end. 18. the mouth wide open in a big happy laugh, rounded, the inside pink with a little pink tongue, no teeth. 19. the mouth open in a small round 'o', the inside pink. 20. the mouth in a small sad frown. 21. the mouth wide open in a big round yawn, the inside pink with a little tongue, no teeth. 22. the mouth closed and chewing: a short, bunched, wavy closed line with puffed-out corners, as when munching with the mouth full. 23. the mouth sobbing: a small open downturned frown with a little pink inside.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.

animations.description: the Stegosaurus plods slowly along on its four stubby legs, its head nodding gently, then stops.
the Stegosaurus crouches, gives a tiny happy bounce off the ground and lands with a little squash.
the Stegosaurus shakes its head no.
the Stegosaurus looks one way, then the other, then back.
the Stegosaurus laughs and laughs, its round tummy bouncing with giggles.
the Stegosaurus does a happy little dance, swaying from side to side, lifting its front feet in turn and swinging its spiky tail.
the Stegosaurus talks, its mouth moving, its head bobbing a little.
the Stegosaurus cries, head down, little tears falling, its tummy shaking with sobs.
the Stegosaurus gives a big yawn, lies down with its legs tucked under and falls asleep, then wakes up, blinks, smiles and gets up.

pause.shows: the Stegosaurus lying down fast asleep, legs tucked under, eyes shut, head drooped

animations.description: the Stegosaurus shivers and trembles, cold or scared, its plates quivering.
the Stegosaurus playfully swishes its spiky tail gently from side to side.
the Stegosaurus bends down, bites off a fern frond and munches it, munch, munch, then licks its lips happily.
the Stegosaurus lowers its snout and sniffs, sniff, sniff, then lifts its head with a happy smile.
the Stegosaurus lies down on its tummy, lifts its plates up to the sun and closes its eyes happily, warm and cosy, then gets up again.

pause.shows: the Stegosaurus lying on its tummy in the sun, plates up, chin up, eyes closed happily

animations.description: the Stegosaurus goes all shy, tucks its head down a little and smiles with happy eyes, swaying bashfully.

pause.shows: the Stegosaurus shy and bashful, head tucked a little, smiling with happy eyes

animations.description: the Stegosaurus stretches its head up and its tail out long with a big yawn, then relaxes with a happy sigh.

pause.shows: the Stegosaurus stretching tall, head up and tail out, mid-yawn
